## App de dietas personalizadas para pacientes MASLD ## Step 15l: very high-kcal diets (>= 2800 kcal) get larger starch and bread portions, up to 5 tablespoons of oil and a triple nut mix; Step 15k: patient data start empty (nothing is calculated until they are filled in); clearer "remo con goma elástica" exercise; food names spelled "hervido/hervida" as in the corrected Excel; larger bread and oat portions in diets of >= 2000 kcal; 2-4 tablespoons of oil for everyone; peas only as legume; name aliases library(shiny) alimentos <- read.csv("alimentos.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8", check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) names(alimentos)[grepl("^Raci", names(alimentos))] <- "racion_g" # avoid accents in code names(alimentos)[grepl("^Pu.ado", names(alimentos))] <- "punado_g" platos <- read.csv("platos.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8", check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) # ===================== Helpers ===================== # Excel-style rounding (halves away from zero); base R round() rounds halves to even round_excel <- function(x, digits = 0) { sign(x) * floor(abs(x) * 10^digits + 0.5 + 1e-9) / 10^digits } fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, decimal.mark = ",") r5 <- function(x) pmax(5, round_excel(x / 5) * 5) # portions rounded to 5 g cuch <- function(n) paste(n, ifelse(n == 1, "cucharada sopera", "cucharadas soperas")) # Fat share: 35 %, lowered (never below 30 %) so carbohydrates stay >= 40 % fat_share <- function(kcal, prot_g) max(0.30, min(0.35, 0.60 - prot_g * 4 / kcal)) SAT_MAX <- 0.10 # saturated fat < 10 % of kcal activity_factors <- c("Sedentaria" = 1.2, "Ligera" = 1.375, "Moderada" = 1.55, "Alta" = 1.725, "Muy alta" = 1.9) DIAS <- c("Lunes", "Martes", "Miércoles", "Jueves", "Viernes", "Sábado", "Domingo") MOMENTOS <- c("Desayuno", "Almuerzo", "Comida", "Merienda", "Cena") # Weekly protein plan for the 6 non-free days (lunch / dinner) by type of diet # L legumes, C white meat, P fish, H egg, M seafood, T tofu COD <- c(L = "Legumbre", C = "Carne blanca", P = "Pescado", H = "Huevo", M = "Marisco", T = "Tofu") plan_d <- function(comida, cena, prohib = "") list(comida = unname(COD[strsplit(comida, "")[[1]]]), cena = unname(COD[strsplit(cena, "")[[1]]]), prohib = unname(COD[strsplit(prohib, "")[[1]]])) PLAN_DIETA <- list( "Omnívora" = plan_d("LCLPLC", "PHPCHP"), # fish 4, white meat 3, egg 2, legumes 3 "Sin carne" = plan_d("LMLPLP", "PHPMHP", "C"), # fish 5, seafood 2, egg 2, legumes 3 "Sin pescado" = plan_d("LCLCLC", "CHCHCH", "PM"), # white meat 6, egg 3, legumes 3 "Vegetariana (sin carne ni pescado)" = plan_d("LLLLLL", "HTHTHH", "CPM")) # legumes 6, egg 4, tofu 2 DIETAS <- names(PLAN_DIETA) PAN <- "Pan integral rebanada pequeña" ACEITE <- "Aceite de oliva virgen extra" PREF_ACEITE <- 0.01 # small preference for 4 cooking tablespoons of oil a day; never above the kcal/fat targets ACEITE_DES <- 5 # 1 dessert spoon of oil on the toast # Allowed portion sizes (Aparicio: small/large = -/+15 %) size_f <- c(0.75, 0.85, 1, 1.15, 1.5) # Larger portions only for high-kcal diets: options above GMAX_* only from KCAL_ALTA (2000 kcal), # and options above GMAX2_* only from KCAL_MUY_ALTA (2800 kcal) KCAL_ALTA <- 2000 KCAL_MUY_ALTA <- 2800 size_f_alta <- c(1.75, 2) # starchy portions, only from KCAL_MUY_ALTA pan_des_g <- c(25, 55, 80, 110, 135, 165) pan_des_lab <- c("1 rebanada pequeña", "1 rebanada grande", "1 rebanada grande y 1 pequeña", "2 rebanadas grandes", "2 rebanadas grandes y 1 pequeña", "3 rebanadas grandes") pan_plato_g <- c(25, 55, 60, 100, 135, 165, 220) pan_plato_lab <- c("1 rebanada pequeña", "1 rebanada grande", "1 bocadillo pequeño", "1 bocadillo mediano", "1 bocadillo grande", "3 rebanadas grandes", "4 rebanadas grandes") pan_extra_g <- c(0, 25, 55, 80, 110, 135) # optional bread with dishes that have carbs pan_extra_lab <- c("", "1 rebanada pequeña", "1 rebanada grande", "1 rebanada grande y 1 pequeña", "2 rebanadas grandes", "2 rebanadas grandes y 1 pequeña") GMAX_PAN_DES <- 110; GMAX_PAN_PLATO <- 100; GMAX_PAN_EXTRA <- 80; GMAX_AVENA <- 60 GMAX2_PAN_DES <- 135; GMAX2_PAN_PLATO <- 165; GMAX2_PAN_EXTRA <- 110; GMAX2_AVENA <- 80; GMAX2_CEREAL <- 120 # "1 rebanada pequeña" -> "1 rebanada pequeña de pan integral" de_pan <- function(lab, a = PAN) { pan <- sub(" (rebanada|bocadillo|molde|tostado).*$", "", tolower(a)) ifelse(lab == "", "", paste(lab, "de", pan)) } cereal_g <- c(40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 120, 140, 160) # 140 and 160 only from KCAL_MUY_ALTA # Bread in slices: closest combination of large (55 g) and small (25 g) slices, few pieces preferred pan_casero <- function(g) { op <- expand.grid(gr = 0:3, pq = 0:2) op <- op[op$gr + op$pq > 0, ] o <- op[which.min(abs(55 * op$gr + 25 * op$pq - g) + 3 * (op$gr + op$pq)), ] if (o$gr == 0) return(if (o$pq == 1) "1 rebanada pequeña" else paste(o$pq, "rebanadas pequeñas")) t <- if (o$gr == 1) "1 rebanada grande" else paste(o$gr, "rebanadas grandes") if (o$pq == 0) t else paste(t, "y", o$pq, if (o$pq == 1) "pequeña" else "pequeñas") } # ===================== Foods ===================== NUT0 <- c(kcal = 0, prot = 0, hc = 0, grasa = 0, sat = 0) per_g <- function(a) { f <- alimentos[alimentos$Alimento == a, ] if (nrow(f) == 0 || is.na(f$kcal_100g[1])) return(NUT0) v <- c(kcal = f$kcal_100g[1], prot = f$proteina_100g[1], hc = f$Hidratos_100g[1], grasa = f$Grasas_total_100g[1], sat = f$Grasas_saturadas_100g[1]) / 100 v[is.na(v)] <- 0 v } racion <- function(a) { r <- alimentos$racion_g[alimentos$Alimento == a][1] if (length(r) == 0 || is.na(r) || r == 0) 100 else r } grupo <- function(a) { g <- alimentos$Grupo_piramide[alimentos$Alimento == a][1] if (length(g) == 0) NA_character_ else g } # Tolerant food-name matching: case, spaces, aliases, extra words and small typos norm <- function(x) { # lower case, no accents, no leading quantity x <- chartr("áéíóúüÁÉÍÓÚÜ", "aeiouuAEIOUU", tolower(gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(x)))) sub("^[0-9]+ ", "", x) # "2 huevos" -> "huevos" } alias <- c("tomate fresco" = "Tomate", "tomate natural" = "Tomate triturado natural lata", "cebolla" = "Cebolla cocinada", "pollo" = "Pechuga de pollo plancha", "pavo" = "Pavo plancha", "gambas" = "Gamba hervida", "gamba" = "Gamba hervida", "acelgas" = "Acelgas hervidas") claves <- c(names(alias), norm(alimentos$Alimento)) valores <- c(unname(alias), alimentos$Alimento) match_food <- function(x) { n <- norm(x) i <- match(n, claves) if (!is.na(i)) return(valores[i]) pre <- which(startsWith(n, paste0(claves, " "))) # "Berenjena con aceite..." -> "Berenjena" if (length(pre)) return(valores[pre[which.max(nchar(claves[pre]))]]) d <- adist(n, claves)[1, ] # small typos if (min(d) <= (if (nchar(n) >= 8) 2 else 1)) return(valores[which.min(d)]) # short names: 1 typo only (pollo is not gallo) NA_character_ } grupos_prot <- c("pescado" = "Pescado", "carne blanca" = "Carne blanca", "carne" = "Carne blanca", "huevo" = "Huevo", "huevos" = "Huevo", "marisco" = "Marisco", "legumbre" = "Legumbre") no_encontrados <- character(0) resolver <- function(x) { n <- norm(x) if (n %in% names(grupos_prot)) return(paste0("GRUPO:", grupos_prot[[n]])) m <- match_food(x) if (is.na(m)) no_encontrados <<- c(no_encontrados, x) m } lista <- function(x, sep = ",") { if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || trimws(x) == "") return(character(0)) y <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, sep, fixed = TRUE))) y[y != ""] } cat_token <- function(t) if (startsWith(t, "GRUPO:")) sub("GRUPO:", "", t) else if (t == "Tofu") "Tofu" else grupo(t) # ===================== Dishes ===================== platos_l <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(platos)), function(i) { p <- platos[i, ] res <- function(v) { r <- vapply(v, resolver, character(1)); unname(r[!is.na(r)]) } verd <- res(lista(p$VERDURA)) hid <- res(lista(p$HIDRATO))[1] leg <- res(lista(p$LEGUMBRE))[1] prot <- Filter(length, lapply(lista(p$PROTEINA, "/"), function(o) res(lista(o, "+")))) cats <- unique(c(if (!is.na(leg)) "Legumbre", unlist(lapply(prot, function(o) vapply(o, cat_token, character(1)))))) mom <- norm(p$MOMENTO) list(nombre = p$PLATO, primero = identical(norm(p$TIPO), "primero"), comida = grepl("comida", mom), cena = grepl("cena", mom), verd = verd, hid = hid, leg = leg, prot = prot, cats = unname(cats[!is.na(cats)])) }) no_encontrados <- unique(no_encontrados) pool <- function(g) { if (g == "Tofu") return("Tofu") a <- alimentos$Alimento[which(alimentos$Grupo_piramide == g & !is.na(alimentos$kcal_100g))] if (g == "Pescado") a <- a[!grepl("lata|enlatad|ahumad", a, ignore.case = TRUE)] a } verd_pool <- alimentos$Alimento[which(alimentos$Grupo_piramide == "Verduras" & alimentos$racion_g >= 200)] leg_pool <- alimentos$Alimento[which(alimentos$Grupo_piramide == "Legumbre" & alimentos$racion_g >= 150)] menos_usado <- function(opciones, usados) { # least used option, random tie-break u <- vapply(opciones, function(o) sum(usados == o), numeric(1)) cand <- opciones[u == min(u)] cand[sample.int(length(cand), 1)] } # ===================== Portions ===================== opts_prot <- function(a) { if (grepl("huevo", a, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(list(g = c(63, 126), lab = c("1 huevo", "2 huevos"))) if (grepl("lata", a, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(list(g = c(56, 82, 112), lab = paste(c("1 lata pequeña", "1 lata grande", "2 latas pequeñas"), "de", tolower(sub(" en lata", "", a))))) base <- racion(a) if (grupo(a) %in% c("Pescado", "Carne blanca", "Marisco")) base <- min(base, 150) # one fillet list(g = r5(base * size_f), lab = "") } opts_hid <- function(a) { if (grepl("^pan", a, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(list(g = pan_plato_g, lab = de_pan(pan_plato_lab, a), gmax = GMAX_PAN_PLATO, gmax2 = GMAX2_PAN_PLATO)) if (grepl("crud", a, ignore.case = TRUE)) return(list(g = cereal_g, lab = "", gmax = GMAX2_CEREAL, gmax2 = GMAX2_CEREAL)) max_normal <- r5(racion(a) * max(size_f)) list(g = r5(racion(a) * c(size_f, size_f_alta)), lab = "", gmax = max_normal, gmax2 = max_normal) } # One line of the menu: household measure first, grams in brackets equiv_casera <- function(a, g) { # raw cereals: handfuls (puñados) if (!identical(grupo(a), "Cereal")) return("") p <- alimentos$punado_g[alimentos$Alimento == a][1] if (is.na(p) && grepl("^(pasta|arroz)", a, ignore.case = TRUE)) p <- 25 if (is.na(p)) return("") n <- round_excel(2 * g / p) / 2; ent <- floor(n) if (ent == 0) return("medio puñado") paste0(ent, if (ent == 1) " puñado" else " puñados", if (n > ent) " y medio" else "") } # Household units of vegetables and fruit (Aparicio A, Perea JM. Tablas de peso de raciones # estándar, de unidades de alimentos, y otras unidades caseras. Nutriguía) # tipo "pieza": fractions of one medium piece; "cuenta": number of units uds <- function(alimento, uno, varios, g, tipo = "pieza", peq = NA, peq_txt = "") data.frame(alimento, uno, varios, g, tipo, peq, peq_txt, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) UNIDADES <- rbind( uds("Tomate", "tomate", "tomates", 150, peq = 90, peq_txt = "tomate pequeño"), uds("Calabacín", "calabacín", "calabacines", 350), uds("Berenjena", "berenjena", "berenjenas", 300, peq = 200, peq_txt = "berenjena pequeña"), uds("Cebolla cruda", "cebolla", "cebollas", 150, peq = 100, peq_txt = "cebolla pequeña"), uds("Cebolla cocinada", "cebolla", "cebollas", 150, peq = 100, peq_txt = "cebolla pequeña"), uds("Zanahoria", "zanahoria", "zanahorias", 100, peq = 50, peq_txt = "zanahoria pequeña"), uds("Pepino", "pepino", "pepinos", 125), uds("Pimiento rojo", "pimiento rojo grande", "pimientos rojos grandes", 300), uds("Pimiento verde", "pimiento verde", "pimientos verdes", 75), uds("Aguacate", "aguacate pequeño", "aguacates pequeños", 125), uds("Champiñones", "champiñón", "champiñones", 30, "cuenta"), uds("Lechuga", "hoja de lechuga", "hojas de lechuga", 17, "cuenta"), uds("Espinacas", "plato de espinacas", "platos de espinacas", 240), uds("Acelgas hervidas", "plato de acelgas", "platos de acelgas", 300), uds("Judía verde", "plato de judías verdes", "platos de judías verdes", 225), uds("Brócoli hervido", "plato de brócoli", "platos de brócoli", 300), uds("Coliflor", "plato de coliflor", "platos de coliflor", 300), uds("Coliflor hervida", "plato de coliflor", "platos de coliflor", 300), uds("Manzana", "manzana", "manzanas", 200, peq = 150, peq_txt = "manzana pequeña"), uds("Pera", "pera", "peras", 165, peq = 135, peq_txt = "pera pequeña"), uds("Naranja", "naranja", "naranjas", 225, peq = 150, peq_txt = "naranja pequeña"), uds("Nectarina", "nectarina", "nectarinas", 200, peq = 130, peq_txt = "nectarina pequeña"), uds("Melocotón", "melocotón", "melocotones", 200, peq = 150, peq_txt = "melocotón pequeño"), uds("Plátano", "plátano", "plátanos", 160, peq = 125, peq_txt = "plátano pequeño"), uds("Kiwi", "kiwi", "kiwis", 100, peq = 75, peq_txt = "kiwi pequeño"), uds("Mandarina", "mandarina", "mandarinas", 90), uds("caqui", "caqui", "caquis", 200), uds("Ciruela", "ciruela", "ciruelas", 65), uds("Albaricoque", "albaricoque", "albaricoques", 50), uds("Mango", "mango pequeño", "mangos pequeños", 380), uds("Cereza", "cereza", "cerezas", 5, "cuenta"), uds("Melón", "rodaja mediana de melón", "rodajas medianas de melón", 200), uds("Sandía", "rodaja de sandía", "rodajas de sandía", 350), uds("Piña", "rodaja de piña", "rodajas de piña", 225)) frac_txt <- function(q, uno, varios) { # 0.75 -> "¾ de calabacín" ent <- floor(q); r <- q - ent fr <- c("0.25" = "¼", "0.5" = "½", "0.75" = "¾")[as.character(r)] if (ent == 0) return(paste0(fr, if (r == 0.5) " " else " de ", uno)) if (r == 0) return(paste(ent, if (ent == 1) uno else varios)) paste(ent, "y", fr, varios) } medida_casera <- function(a, g) { u <- UNIDADES[UNIDADES$alimento == a, ] if (nrow(u) == 0) return("") if (u$tipo == "cuenta") { n <- max(1, round_excel(g / u$g)) return(paste(n, if (n == 1) u$uno else u$varios)) } if (!is.na(u$peq) && g < 0.9 * u$g && abs(g - u$peq) <= 0.2 * u$peq) return(paste("1", u$peq_txt)) q <- round_excel(4 * g / u$g) / 4 if (q == 0) return(paste("un trozo de", u$uno)) frac_txt(q, u$uno, u$varios) } # Fruit "a elegir": 3 options from a group of pieces with similar kcal, rotating every day FRUTA_GRUPOS <- list( c("Kiwi", "Melón", "Pera", "Nectarina", "Albaricoque"), # ~50-65 kcal c("Sandía", "Cereza", "Melocotón", "Naranja", "Mandarina", "Ciruela"), # ~65-85 kcal c("Manzana", "Piña", "Plátano", "caqui")) # ~100-140 kcal FRUTA_GRUPOS <- lapply(FRUTA_GRUPOS, function(gr) gr[gr %in% alimentos$Alimento]) FRUTA_N <- c("Mandarina" = 2, "Ciruela" = 2, "Albaricoque" = 3) # small fruits: several units fruta_g_op <- function(a, peq = FALSE) { n <- FRUTA_N[a] if (is.na(n)) return(if (peq) r5(0.75 * racion(a)) else racion(a)) (if (peq) max(1, round_excel(0.75 * n)) else n) * UNIDADES$g[UNIDADES$alimento == a] } fruta_nut <- function(ops, peq = FALSE) # mean of the options Reduce(`+`, lapply(ops, function(o) per_g(o) * fruta_g_op(o, peq))) / length(ops) fruta_txt <- function(ops, peq = FALSE, momento = "Almuerzo") { t <- vapply(ops, function(o) { g <- fruta_g_op(o, peq); paste0(medida_casera(o, g), " (", fmt(g), " g)") }, character(1)) cab <- if (momento == "Almuerzo") "Fruta a elegir: " else "Fruta de postre o en la merienda, a elegir: " paste0(cab, paste(t[-length(t)], collapse = ", "), " o ", t[length(t)]) } linea <- function(a, g, lab) { if (a == "Fruta a elegir") return(lab) u <- if (grepl("^Leche", a)) " ml" else " g" if (lab == "") lab <- medida_casera(a, g) if (lab != "") return(paste0(lab, if (g > 0) paste0(" (", fmt(g), u, ")"))) eq <- equiv_casera(a, g) nom <- if (a == "Conejo") "Conejo con hueso" else a # table values for rabbit are per 100 g with bone paste0(nom, " ", fmt(g), u, if (eq != "") paste0(" (", eq, ")")) } item <- function(momento, alimento, g, lab = "", plato = "", fruta = FALSE, gmax = Inf, gmax2 = Inf) list(momento = momento, alimento = alimento, g = g, lab = rep_len(lab, length(g)), plato = plato, fruta = fruta, gmax = gmax, gmax2 = gmax2) # largest option below KCAL_ALTA / below KCAL_MUY_ALTA item_fruta <- function(momento, ops) list(momento = momento, alimento = "Fruta a elegir", g = 1, lab = "", plato = "", fruta = TRUE, opciones = ops) items_plato <- function(momento, nombre, verd, hid, leg, prots) { it <- list() if (length(verd)) { es_grasa <- vapply(verd, function(a) identical(grupo(a), "Aceite"), logical(1)) suma <- sum(vapply(verd[!es_grasa], racion, numeric(1))) s <- if (suma > 0) min(1, 350 / suma) else 1 # one plate of vegetables (max ~350 g) for (a in verd) it[[length(it) + 1]] <- if (identical(grupo(a), "Aceite")) item(momento, a, 30, "", nombre) else item(momento, a, r5(racion(a) * s), "", nombre) } if (!is.na(leg)) it[[length(it) + 1]] <- item(momento, leg, r5(racion(leg) * size_f), "", nombre) for (a in prots) { o <- opts_prot(a); it[[length(it) + 1]] <- item(momento, a, o$g, o$lab, nombre) } h <- if (is.na(hid)) PAN else hid # dishes without carbohydrate get bread o <- opts_hid(h) it[[length(it) + 1]] <- item(momento, h, o$g, o$lab, nombre, gmax = o$gmax, gmax2 = o$gmax2) if (!is.na(hid) && !grepl("^pan", hid, ignore.case = TRUE)) # bread on the side, only if needed it[[length(it) + 1]] <- item(momento, PAN, pan_extra_g, de_pan(pan_extra_lab), nombre, gmax = GMAX_PAN_EXTRA, gmax2 = GMAX2_PAN_EXTRA) it } # ===================== Rotating sides and nuts ===================== # "... a la plancha con verduras" and "Salteado ..." dishes: the vegetable side rotates over the # cooked vegetables of the table and, if the dish has no carbohydrate, so does the side carbohydrate es_rotativo <- function(nombre) grepl("plancha con verduras|^salteado", nombre, ignore.case = TRUE) CORTO <- c("Brócoli hervido" = "brócoli", "Coliflor hervida" = "coliflor", "Acelgas hervidas" = "acelgas", "Judía verde" = "judías verdes", "Espinacas" = "espinacas", "Calabacín" = "calabacín", "Berenjena" = "berenjena", "Champiñones" = "champiñones", "Patata asada" = "patata asada", "Boniato" = "boniato", "Cuscús" = "cuscús", "Quinoa" = "quinoa", "Arroz integral crudo" = "arroz integral") GUARNICION <- intersect(names(CORTO)[1:8], alimentos$Alimento) # peas are a legume, not a side ACOMP <- c(PAN, intersect(names(CORTO)[9:13], alimentos$Alimento)) # PAN = bread only # Nuts of the afternoon snack: always 2 walnuts + a small mix of two other nuts that changes # every day (unit weights from Aparicio & Perea) NUEZ_UD <- c("Almendras crudas" = 1.5, "Avellanas" = 1, "Pistachos" = 1, "Anacardos" = 1.5) NUEZ_N <- c("Almendras crudas" = 3, "Avellanas" = 3, "Pistachos" = 4, "Anacardos" = 2) NUEZ_TXT <- c("Almendras crudas" = "almendras", "Avellanas" = "avellanas", "Pistachos" = "pistachos", "Anacardos" = "anacardos") MEZCLAS <- list(c("Avellanas", "Anacardos"), c("Almendras crudas", "Pistachos"), c("Avellanas", "Almendras crudas"), c("Pistachos", "Anacardos"), c("Almendras crudas", "Anacardos"), c("Avellanas", "Pistachos")) item_mezcla <- function(par) { # e.g. "3 avellanas y 2 anacardos (6 g)" g <- NUEZ_N[par] * NUEZ_UD[par] nut <- Reduce(`+`, Map(function(a, x) per_g(a) * x, par, g)) txt <- function(k) paste(k * NUEZ_N[par[1]], NUEZ_TXT[par[1]], "y", k * NUEZ_N[par[2]], NUEZ_TXT[par[2]]) it <- item("Merienda", "Frutos secos variados", c(sum(g), 0, 2 * sum(g), 3 * sum(g)), # double: only >= KCAL_ALTA, c(txt(1), "", txt(2), txt(3)), gmax = sum(g), gmax2 = 2 * sum(g)) # triple: only >= KCAL_MUY_ALTA it$nut_g <- nut / sum(g) # per gram of the mix it } nut_de <- function(x) if (!is.null(x$nut_g)) x$nut_g else per_g(x$alimento) # Weekly limits of starchy foods: pasta, rice and potato at most 2 times a week each, and only # bread or potato at dinner tipo_hc <- function(a) { if (is.na(a)) return(NA_character_) if (grepl("^(pasta|cusc)", a, ignore.case = TRUE)) "pasta" else if (grepl("^(arroz|quinoa)", a, ignore.case = TRUE)) "arroz" else if (grepl("^(patata|boniato)", a, ignore.case = TRUE)) "patata" else NA_character_ } MAX_HC <- 2 # ===================== Breakfasts
